items.title: ARTEX
items.description: AI 自主渗透测试系统 | 百度“agent+”攻防挑战赛冠军项目
items.summary: ARTEX is an open-source autonomous penetration testing system written in Go with a Next.js frontend, released under AGPL-3.0. It has won Baidu's "agent+" attack-defense challenge and emphasizes agent autonomy in exploring a defined asset scope. The system features a planner to generate attack intentions, multiple workers to execute these intentions using real security tools, and a dashboard for task management, token consumption, activity feed, exploration graph, findings, and asset lists. It supports ScopeSentry integration for automatic asset synchronization and is packaged as a single binary for Linux amd64/arm64, macOS, and Windows.

items.title: agentmemoryrepo

It features 12 auto-capture hooks and 54 MCP tools, and it is maintained by RAVBYTE TECHNOLOGIES PRIVATE LIMITED. items.title: agentcraft
items.summary: AgentCraft is an open-source tool that reimagines AI coding agents through an RTS-style command center, allowing users to manage AI agents in a game interface with missions, fog of war, skill scrolls, and achievements. It installs lightweight hooks into agent CLIs to report session events to a server that renders everything in a browser-based game UI. Additionally, AgentCraft is a Spigot plugin for Minecraft that spawns intelligent NPC agents backed by Claude, capable of autonomously navigating, building, mining, and conversing with players. AgentCraft is designed for agent orchestration, inspired by real-time strategy games, to manage multiple AI agents effectively with features like heroes, buildings, real-time task management, and dynamic conflict resolution.

items.title: mesh-avatar-studio
items.description: Turn one illustration into an animated 2D mesh avatar with a coding agent and a local editor
items.summary: Mesh Avatar Studio transforms a single static illustration into an animated 2D mesh avatar that blinks, talks, turns its head, breathes, and sways its hair. A coding agent (Claude Code or Codex) prepares the avatar from your image, and you fine-tune it in a local editor with a live preview. The process involves four steps: the agent creates the avatar, and you fine-tune it in the editor. Best results come from a front-facing, head-and-shoulders PNG with a transparent background. The project is saved in `projects//`, which is never committed. Requires Node.js 22.17+.

items.title: SCM
items.description: Deep AI search for every photo and every frame of video in any folder on macOS
items.summary: SCM, an MIT-licensed Electron app for macOS, indexes every photo and every video frame in watched folders on-device to enable offline CLIP search. It uses CLIP ViT-L/14@336 for visual indexing and offers five search modes: Files, Scenes, OCR via Tesseract, Dialogue via Whisper transcription, and an optional local LLMs 'Ask' chat. Unlike Apple Photos, SCM targets folders outside the Photos library, including external-drive archives and project exports.

items.title: openqodex
items.description: Open source AI code review for Claude Code and Codex, before you push. Scanners (SAST, secrets, dependencies, lint) on the lines you changed, then a separate reviewer process that checks every scanner finding and is given every changed line. No other API key.
items.summary: OpenQodex is an open source AI code review tool for Claude Code and Codex that runs before you push your code. It uses one command, `openqodex review`, to analyze your changes, including commits not yet pushed and uncommitted changes, and runs relevant scanners like SAST, secrets, dependencies, and lint on the lines you changed. It then employs a separate reviewer process to check each scanner finding. OpenQodex does not require any API key, account, or server other than having Claude Code or Codex installed and logged in. It generates reports in various formats and can be configured to block pushes based on severity settings.

items.title: pi-pocket
items.description: A durable, multiplayer, mobile-first web app for Pi agents, built on Pi Durable
items.summary: Pi-pocket is a durable, multiplayer, mobile-first web app for Pi agents, built on Pi Durable. Pi Durable is an experimental framework from Earendil, released alongside Pi 1.0, for building applications around agent conversations that need to survive restarts. It treats conversations as durable state, checkpointing them, allowing resumption after a crash, and enabling multiple concurrent conversations, each with its own model, tools, instructions, and working directory. Pi Durable is a separate package from the main Pi framework, meant for applications that need agent conversations to persist across process restarts.

items.title: box
items.description: Run AI agents in a sandbox that restricts what they can execute, read, write, and reach on the network. Box combines OS isolation with default-deny Dogwood policies and credential injection that keeps secrets outside the agent. Written in Rust. Supports macOS on Apple silicon, with Linux support planned.
items.summary: The sources indicate that Box is an open-source AI agent sandbox that combines OS-level isolation with default-deny Dogwood policies to restrict what the agent can execute, read, write, and reach on the network. It is currently written in Rust and supports macOS on Apple silicon, with plans to expand to other operating systems. The containment layer uses OS-level isolation mechanisms like macOS Seatbelt, and the policy layer governs agent actions through the Dogwood Local Engine. The sources also highlight the importance of credential brokering and deny-by-default egress policies to prevent prompt injection and secret exfiltration.

OpenAlice is experimental software in active development and is not recommended for live trading with real funds without full understanding and acceptance of the risks involved.

items.title: 4DCodeBench

items.summary: 4DCodeBench is a benchmark for 4D inverse graphics through code generation, where agents reconstruct dynamic scenes from video as executable graphics programs. The benchmark evaluates this capability by curating real-world videos and constructing synthetic scenes spanning diverse physical phenomena, including deformation, fluid flow, and fracture. The sources indicate that strong static reconstruction capabilities do not yet translate into reliable reconstruction of complex dynamics, and the benchmark is available at a specified URL.

items.title: Sentry
items.description: Learning to Recover from LLM Agent Failures at Test Time
items.summary: Sentry is an external runtime failure management layer for LLM agents that helps them fix invalid actions and recover from failures. It detects failures, guides recovery through hard and soft repair methods, and verifies if the agent has successfully recovered. Sentry has shown an 81.7% recovery rate across 939 detected failures and has achieved an average improvement of 37% over the strongest runtime-intervention baseline and 39% over the strongest context-evolution baseline. It also uses fewer tokens compared to other runtime methods while saving time per task.

items.title: PiDurableKit
items.description: Durable AI agents for Apple platforms: pi-durable on JavaScriptCore with a Swift API
items.summary: Pi Durable is a standalone framework from Arendelle, released alongside Pi 1.0, designed for applications needing agent conversations to persist across process restarts. It allows a single harness to run multiple concurrent conversations, each with its own model, tools, instructions, and working directory, and can checkpoint conversations to resume after a crash. Pi Durable is part of the broader Pi AI agent toolkit, which includes a unified LLM API, agent loop, and coding agent CLI. It is considered a better option for its focus on agnosticism compared to other frameworks like Vercel's SDK and OpenAi's Agent.

items.title: paperfold
items.description: Zoom any paper for your better understanding
items.summary: Zoom Paper is a platform that helps you create, manage, and collaborate on rich text documents including tables, shapes, and images. The YouTube video titled "Zoom Paper Demo: AI-Powered Documents for Modern Teams" shows how this AI-powered document editor helps modern teams draft, edit, and turn conversations into clear, connected documents. The other YouTube video titled "Exponential growth: How folding paper can get you to the Moon" discusses the mathematical concept of how folding a paper in half repeatedly can lead to extraordinary thicknesses, but it does not relate to Zoom Paper.
